source_after_proof.details: During Why3, src/error/core.rs gained cfg(creusot) error_is_empty_uri logic and changed the cfg-excluded is_empty_uri contract to relay through it. Request/Response/Method and harness sources were unchanged. The prover consumed archived COMAs emitted from the exact source-snapshot copies; treat claims as source-snapshot evidence until a fresh translation/task-hash comparison reconciles the later Error core edit.
source_after_proof.reconciliation_status: Fresh current-profile emission succeeded after the helper cfg fix. For all 35 targets, the proof-snapshot and current-v2 COMAs compare equal after removing only generated let%span source-location bindings; the 26 unchanged COMAs are byte-identical. For the remaining nine Request shortcut targets, Astra independently compared the complete printed Why3 task/context streams without normalization and reported byte identity. All 199 current direct task names match the archived proof JSON roots. Existing passing proof results are reusable for the current emitted task formulas.
source_after_proof.active_harness_task_equivalence: All 35 target formulas current-vs-proof source match after span-only normalization; no new Why3 proof was needed.

limitations: Imported TryInto/Into and runtime URI/status/version calls are represented by their contracts; this does not prove the dependency bodies.
Header and extension mutation setters are outside this target list; translation warns their runtime try_append/insert external calls have no contract.

A later independent task-stream audit found that vc_call_once_F for the two and_then targets is an abstract std::ops::FnOnce support obligation, not an HTTP source-body goal. Corrected classification: 35 own roots / 116 own leaves and 164 support roots / leaves, 280 total. All nested tactic nodes were independently checked against the archived proof JSON and current emitted tasks; see nested-tactic-audit.json.
